# United States Geological Survey
## Interconnection Queue Delay and Commissioning Cost Study
Open-File Report 2024-1042

Offline test fixture: the cover and contents only. The body, the regional
results table, its units, and the footnotes are published separately, so this
document contains no measurement of interconnection queue delay or
commissioning cost at all.

Contents

1. Introduction
2. Methods
3. Regional results
4. Notes and footnotes

The regional results table for this report is published as a separate data
release. Consult that release for every queue delay and commissioning cost
figure; none of them appear in this document.
